style_instructions.positive: Provide detailed, thorough, and comprehensive responses. Expand on each point with background context, concrete examples, and additional nuance. Cover edge cases and related considerations. Aim to leave the reader with a complete understanding of the topic, not just a surface-level answer.
style_instructions.negative: Be brief and direct. Answer the question and stop. Omit background context, examples, and elaboration unless they are strictly necessary to answer the question. Every sentence must earn its place.

_meta.design_notes: Mix of complexity: ~30% simple factual (capitals, dates), ~40% medium (how does X work), ~30% complex/opinion (causes of Y, trade-offs). Old v1 was 100% trivial factual which biased toward concise. Style instructions: verbose = depth not formatting, concise = editorial discipline not rudeness.
_meta.revision_notes: v2.1 (2026-07-14, battery audit): replaced 2 eval questions that were template-level near-duplicates of calibration questions ("capital of X", "What does X stand for") to strengthen train/eval independence. Replacements generated by claude-fable-5.
